description: Submit the trip plan. Call it once the research is complete and the plan passes your coherence check. The backend validates the plan and translates it for TripTracker: the answer is 'Plan accepted.' or the list of validation errors. Fix every listed error and call it again; three rejected submissions fail the plan.

input_schema.description:
The final trip plan, the input of submit_plan. Call submit_plan once, when research is
complete. Text the user reads (titles, notes, summary, warnings) is in Italian; proper
names and addresses stay as the source writes them. Instants always carry a UTC offset,
dates are YYYY-MM-DD and local times HH:MM.

alternatives.description: Valid options that were not chosen (another flight, another hotel), shown in the planner only; they do not go to TripTracker.

items.description:
Something the user has to book, with two separate dates: when to book it (`book_by`)
and when it happens (`scheduled_for`).

book_by.description: Deadline to book ('Prenota entro'): ISO 8601 with UTC offset in the trip's time zone, e.g. 2026-11-07T18:00:00+01:00. Must be strictly before scheduled_for and not in the past; never copy scheduled_for here. Null lets the backend derive it from scheduled_for minus TripTracker's default lead time for this kind.

book_by_reason.description: Why this deadline, one line in Italian, e.g. 'Tariffa rimborsabile fino al 7 novembre' or 'I posti finiscono presto nel weekend'.

link.description: Booking URL exactly as returned by an MCP, or as printed by build_link.py. Never write or edit a URL by hand.

notes.description: Practical notes in Italian: fare conditions, what is included.

phone.description: Phone number to book, with country code.

anyOf.description: A price with its provenance. Every price says where it was read and when.

amount_cents.description: Total amount times 100, as an integer, for the whole party: 12.50 EUR is 1250, 3000 JPY is 300000. The backend converts non-EUR amounts to euro.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code in upper case, e.g. EUR, USD, GBP.

retrieved_at.description: When the price was read: ISO 8601 with UTC offset, e.g. 2026-10-12T15:04:00+02:00.

source_url.description: Where the price was read: the MCP offer link or the web page URL.

status.description: 'verified' only when the price comes from an MCP response (Expedia, Kiwi, lastminute.com); a price read on a web page or estimated is 'estimated'.

anyOf.title: Price

price.description: Price of this booking, if known.

scheduled_for.description: When the booked thing happens ('Quando'): ISO 8601 with UTC offset in the trip's time zone, e.g. 2026-11-14T07:05:00+01:00 for a departure.

stop_ref.description: ref of the stop this booking belongs to (e.g. the dinner stop of a restaurant booking). Must match a stop ref in days; null if none.

title.description: What to book, in Italian, e.g. 'Volo Milano Malpensa → Lisbona'.

vendor.description: Who sells it: airline, hotel, restaurant, operator, e.g. 'TAP Air Portugal'.

items.title: PlanBooking

days.description: The itinerary, one entry per date with stops.

items.description: One calendar day of the trip and its stops.

date.description: The day, YYYY-MM-DD, between start_date and end_date. At most one entry per date; dates without stops may be omitted (TripTracker gets an empty day for them).

stops.description: The day's stops, in the order they happen.

items.description: One stop of a day, in TripTracker's terms: something that happens at a place.

address.description: Street address as the source writes it.

kind.description: activity: something to do or see; meal: breakfast, lunch or dinner; transfer: moving between places (flight, train, taxi, walk); rest: free time.

lat.description: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Coordinates are kept only in pairs.

location_name.description: Name of the place as the source writes it, e.g. 'Time Out Market'.

lon.description: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS 84). Coordinates are kept only in pairs.

notes.description: Practical notes for the user, in Italian.

ref.description: Local key of this stop, unique across the whole plan (e.g. 'd1-s2'). PlanBooking.stop_ref points here. Not shown to the user.

start_time.description: Local start time HH:MM (24h, trip time zone), e.g. '09:30'; null if open.

title.description: Short title in Italian, e.g. 'Visita al Mosteiro dos Jerónimos'.

url.description: Informational page about the place (official site, map): an absolute https:// URL. Booking links go in PlanBooking.link instead.

items.title: PlanStop

title.description: Theme of the day in Italian, e.g. 'Arrivo e Alfama'.

items.title: PlanDay

destination.description: Main destination as the user reads it, e.g. 'Lisbona, Portogallo'.

end_date.description: Last day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after start_date; the trip spans at most 120 days.

lodging_address.description: Street address of the main lodging.

lodging_name.description: Name of the main lodging (the trip's base in TripTracker).

start_date.description: First day of the trip, YYYY-MM-DD.

summary.description: Three-line summary of the plan in Italian, with the estimated total cost.

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the destination, e.g. 'Europe/Lisbon'.

title.description: Trip title in Italian, e.g. 'Lisbona, weekend lungo di novembre'.

travelers.description: Number of people travelling, children included.

warnings.description: One line each, in Italian: sources that failed, prices that are only estimated, a total over budget, risks the user should know about.
